scope.gmail: One explicit thread and mailbox, mandatory exact gateway account selector; <=100 messages; plain UTF-8 bodies, participant headers and attachment metadata
scope.calendar: Up to20 exact calendar IDs, <=7-day offset-checked IANA-timezone window, no group expansion, <=1000 total busy intervals
scope.research: Retained original and separate projection use canonical project_artifact refs; both source kinds reopened jointly with exact citation proof
scope.http: At most2 physical gateway POST requests; no client retries, redirects, proxy inheritance, provider fallback, broad search, pagination or implicit authentication refresh
scope.artifacts: Separate exact original/projection approvals; immutable history; publish never refetches; source bytes never accepted from client; pending bundle loss requires new explicit refresh

security_checks: actual registered RPC and strict DTO roundtrip
selected account included in existing gateway wire; rejection has no fallback
live actor/project/policy/run/deadline checks at egress admission and every HTTP edge
existing guarded httpx recipient plan with narrow source-control purpose
existing durable BE03 reservations for every physical gateway attempt
timeout or malformed execute completion retains unknown usage and remote slot; no automatic retry
cost mode unsupported before any HTTP; tokens mode explicitly untracked spend
no $ref retrieval, remote regex execution or recursive schema validators
cross-thread data discarded instead of retained as partial
A-to-B-to-A profile isolation and foreign preparation denial
newer original preserves prior versions and derivative linkage
partial local publication retains exact bundle for idempotent retry
source instructions remain inert data and cannot accept commitments
separate inbox and calendar contracts; no sends/events/invitations
limits: Live gateway account selector support remains unqualified; existing wire contract probe F2 records400 rejection while multi-account is disabled. No selector omission or guessed alternate route was added.
Gateway HTTP attempt accounting does not certify vendor-internal attempts, retries, usage or invoice cost. Only the documented finite read envelopes are admitted; no search/opaque model loop adapter.
Only the documented Composio successful/data envelope with underlying Google resource shapes is supported; unknown vendor normalization/schema constraints return unavailable or partial.
Gmail HTML-only/non-UTF-8/large-body cases retain a bounded correctly scoped original as partial, without inventing decoded text. Attachment bytes are not fetched.
Calendar identity is explicit calendar IDs, not person identity verification. Existing agenda preview still labels supplied snapshots and freshness; no calendar writes.
Pending prepared bytes are volatile, per-agent and bounded. Command audit survives restart and prevents silent refetch; published originals/projections are durable.
Generic web search, broad inbox time-range discovery, sends/calendar mutations, live P08 acceptance, production activation and cost-mode certification are outside this implementation.
